local.label: This computer
local.subtitle: A folder or an archive you already have

git.label: Git or link
git.subtitle: Fetch a repository, a site or a link and pick what to keep

errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer.
errors.proxyHint: Check your connection. If you are behind a proxy, set it in Settings.
errors.authHint: The repository asked for credentials. Make sure your SSH key or Git credential helper works in a terminal first.

batch.title: Import finished
batch.skippedHint: Skipped skills share a name with one already in the library, which was left as it is.

deploy.title: Deploy to agents
deploy.noAgents: No agent is available. Enable one in Settings first.

market.searchScope: Search looks across all of {{marketplace}}, not just the ranking above.
market.emptyDescription: Try a different word, or go back to the rankings.
market.emptyFiltered: This contributor has nothing in the current results.

local.folderDescription: A folder that holds one skill. It is copied into the library; the original stays where it is.
local.archiveDescription: One or more packed skills. When it holds several, you pick which to keep.
local.bulkTitle: Import every skill in a folder
local.bulkDescription: Point at a folder of skill folders. Each one is imported; names already in the library are skipped.
local.pickBulkTitle: Choose the folder that holds your skills
local.nameHint: Optional. Leave empty to use the name written in the skill.
local.dropHint: Drop a skill folder or an archive (.zip, .skill, .tar.gz) anywhere here, or choose one below.

git.urlHint: Nothing is installed yet: it is fetched first so you can choose. Works with Git repositories, links to an archive or a SKILL.md, sites that publish skills (a /.well-known/agent-skills index), and a pasted npx skills add command.
git.previewHint: Tick what you want and rename anything before it lands in the library.
git.missing_one: {{names}} is not in here. Pick from what is, or check the spelling.
git.missing_other: These are not in here: {{names}}. Pick from what is, or check the spelling.
git.alreadyInstalled: Already in the library. Importing it again updates that copy.

repository.title: No skills in this repository
repository.description: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file. For a large repository, paste the link to the exact folder instead.

archive.title: No skills in this archive
archive.description: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file. This archive has none.

file.title: This file is not a skill
file.description: A skill's SKILL.md starts with a name and a description between --- lines.

site.title: No skills could be read from this site
site.description: The site lists skills, but none of them arrived in a usable shape.

git.redirected: This download moved to {{host}}, a different site than the link you pasted. Only install it if you trust that site.
git.agentsNamed: The command asks for {{names}}. After importing, they are ticked in the deploy panel for you to confirm.
git.agentsAll: The command asks for every agent. After importing, all of them are ticked in the deploy panel for you to confirm.
git.agentsUnknown_one: {{names}} is not an agent here, so it is left out.
git.agentsUnknown_other: These are not agents here, so they are left out: {{names}}.
git.privateDescription: Cloning uses the Git on this computer, so whatever works in your terminal works here: an SSH key for git@ addresses, or a credential helper for https. {{app}} never asks for or stores a Git password.
git.noGitDescription: Public repositories on GitHub and GitLab still install: {{app}} downloads them directly. Private repositories and other hosts need Git.

scan.explanation: Importing copies a skill into the library. The agent's own folder is not changed, moved or deleted.
scan.allImported: Everything your agents have is already in the library.
scan.emptyDescription: None of your agents has a skill folder that the library does not already manage.
